relation_to_protocol: additions to results/stage300/stage300_protocol.json; nothing registered there was changed, and the code hashes registered there are unchanged on disk

scripts/stage300_analyze.py.why: aggregation of all records into stage300_analysis.json

scripts/stage300_censor.py.why: registers the 7,200 s per-sample wall for the travellers collection and records the six censored runs with the wall-clock and resident set size measured at the moment they were stopped

scripts/stage300_losscase.py.why: the worst single case, re-solved at its printed support and at every single-anchor neighbour of it

scripts/stage300_lossgap.py.why: quantifies that disagreement over every evaluated run and records the endpoint-substitution trigger condition

scripts/stage300_prune.py.why: fair-panel arm: measures the reference panel DecoDiPhy keeps after preprocess_input and recomputes BOTH Theta_1 (stage 298's exact k=1 routine) and R_dd on that panel

scripts/stage300_report.py.why: table builders read by the document generator

scripts/stage300_resolve.py.why: fairness arm: re-solve DecoDiPhy's own QP (solve_osqp_once) at the support it returned, because the recomputed SSR of the returned configuration disagreed with the loss the tool reports for it

scripts/stage300_routee.py.why: verification route E: Lambda_1 against the tool's own k = 1 ladder loss

scripts/stage300_tdprobe.py.why: cost decomposition of the tool's input stage on one 10,575-leaf stool sample

run_configuration_actually_used.krepp_placement: 60 cases x {dd_default, dd_true_k}, 20 workers, wall 1800 s, RLIMIT_AS 8 GB; 120/120 runs complete
run_configuration_actually_used.travelers_pilot: 1 sample (td_sample_101_published), 1 worker, wall 14400 s, RLIMIT_AS 60 GB
run_configuration_actually_used.travelers_batch: the other 28 samples, 5 workers, wall 21600 s, RLIMIT_AS 30 GB
run_configuration_actually_used.cores: at most 26 of 62 in flight at any time (20 placement workers, then 5 travellers workers + 1 pilot + 1 probe), within the 40-core budget
run_configuration_actually_used.krepp_ani: no new runs: harvested from stages 289/293/294/297

travelers_wall.why: the registered plan left the travellers wall to be sized from the pilot; the pilot did not return, so a wall was set from the budget instead: 29 samples x 2 h / 5 memory-safe concurrent workers is about 11.6 h, the largest per-sample wall that fits a single day of this stage's 40-core allocation
travelers_wall.outcome: 6 of 29 samples attempted, 0 completed, 12.9 core-hours consumed, 9.9-10.8 GiB resident per run at the stop

deviations_from_the_registered_plan: The original plan said the travellers workers would be "sized from the pilot's peak RSS"; the pilot had not finished when the batch was launched, so 5 workers x 30 GB RLIMIT_AS was chosen from its RSS trajectory (5.9 -> 7.5 GB over 50 minutes) and the measured machine headroom.
The analysis, report and table scripts were written after registration and are hashed in this amendment, as is the house pattern.

The travellers collection is reported as a measured cost, not as a fit comparison: 6 of 29 samples attempted, 0 completed within the 7,200 s wall, 23 not attempted.  Theta_1 (imported from stage 298) and Lambda_1 (computed here) are reported for all 29.
